# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 110 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 110

Jesus said: "Anyone who has found their way in the world and grown wealthy must give it all up."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Found their way in the world" — success rendered as navigation
- "Grown wealthy" — the process of accumulation
- "Give it all up" — renunciation as total release
